releaseNotes.headline: Automatic Claude setup and refresh

highlights.detail: Install usAIge or Claude first. Once Claude is open with its normal account setup complete, usAIge detects local usage automatically without Detect or configuration.
highlights.title: Works in either install order

highlights.detail: usAIge checks local usage continuously and can open Claude’s Usage page or resume its existing collector when readings become stale. Claude must remain open; refresh respects retry limits.
highlights.title: Automatic usage refresh

highlights.detail: Claude keeps its own session. usAIge reads validated local usage and reset times without accessing Keychain, passwords, tokens, or cookies.
highlights.title: No extra sign-in or password keys

releaseNotes.summary: Claude usage connects automatically from your existing Claude session, whichever app you install first. usAIge keeps usage current when Claude pauses its own polling, without extra sign-in or setup.
